market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH at ~$2,380 needs ~37% drawdown to hit $1,500. ETH has been highly volatile with recent lows in correction territory. Already touched mid-$2,000s recently. Window includes Nov 24, 2025 onward; ETH may have already approached $1,500 during the late-2025 correction. With 7+ months remaining and ETH historically more volatile than BTC, possible but not high probability.
